svg.title: Wyrd's intended 2028 international network and later African expansion
svg.desc: Planning map, not a map of current offices. A holding in Zug; platforms in Lisbon, Singapore, Dubai, Luanda, Montreal and São Paulo; a Chinese local company in Macau; United States pole in Boston and Colombia pole in Bogotá. Seven African expansion countries are targeted for 2028. Mozambique and Tanzania follow in 2029, Senegal and Namibia in 2030. Country boundaries are genuine Natural Earth 1:110 million geometry, with de facto boundary conventions. City pins are approximate centres.
svg.text: The network we intend to build.
